description: Flat input schema for the avenor_message tool, compiled from schemas/message.input.json's per-action union so an MCP client publishes one object whose property types survive: an integer stays an integer and an object stays an object. Every action's properties appear here, so a field belonging to another action is not a schema error. Per-action admission (required fields, unknown properties, types and limits) belongs to the router, which answers a mismatch at once with the contract's typed invalid_request and its repair text. Generated by internal/messaging/cmd/genschema; do not edit.

action.description: Action to perform: tell — Deliver a message without creating a reply edge; ask — Deliver a message and wait for one reply; reply — Answer an inbound message: an ask through its claim, a tell through the broker's route; resume — Continue a finished run in a new run; withdraw — Retract an ask this caller sent; control_reply — Retained in the contract for the retired claude-channel backend's reply path; no surface can deliver one.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-chosen key that makes a repeated resume replay the first result.

label.description: Display name for the new run; defaults to the prior run's label.

message.description: Text the recipient reads. Question the recipient answers. Reply text the asker reads. Instruction the resumed run receives.

message_id.description: Message id of the ask to withdraw.

payload.description: JSON payload the control channel receives; absent sends an empty object.

reply_to.description: Message id of the inbound message, as an opaque handle.

target.description: Recipient: a reserved self alias, a broker/runtime id, a host-surface public run id, or a peer label. Prior run: a reserved self alias, a broker/runtime id, a host-surface public run id, or a peer label. Opaque control message id, passed through unchanged.

timeout_ms.description: Bounded wait in whole milliseconds, at least zero and at most the shared wait cap (600000); absent or zero uses the shared wait cap.
